scenario: [LUNI.8.8]: forms over one dimension compare base-unit values on both sides. A `celsius` slot holds 21.5_celsius and a `celsius?` slot is absent, both from an `initial:` fact, so no host assertion's conversion is involved. `min(r.t, 30_celsius) == r.t`, `r.t in (18_celsius .. 24_celsius)` and `(r.n ?? 20_celsius) == 20_celsius` each hold, each in its own rule. Exactly ["min", "in", "coalesce"], in source order. An endpoint or default read in the wrong unit misses its rule. PATH PINNED: the `FN_MIN`, interval and coalesce evaluation of a unit literal on each runtime, after `dsc.typecheck.luni_8_8_beside` admits them.
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

const WARM = 21.5_celsius

schema R scope explicit:
    t: celsius
    n: celsius?

initial:
    R t: WARM

rule low:
    R r where min(r.t, 30_celsius) == r.t
->
    log info "min"

rule inside:
    R r where r.t in (18_celsius .. 24_celsius)
->
    log info "in"

rule fallback:
    R r where (r.n ?? 20_celsius) == 20_celsius
->
    log info "coalesce"
